messages:
Aria: Quick thought 10: we keep getting signals that some routes show very low token spend but high amortized cost. I think shared prefetches are getting misattributed. Sketch: a "Prefetch sleuth" panel you open from the cost heatmap that shows lineage from prefetch -> consuming routes -> sample invocations. Screenshot mock: https://img.redwood.dev/mocks/prefetch_sleuth.png :detective:

Aria: UX goals: 1) fast path to see top prefetch_ids for a cell, 2) ability to toggle 'include credits' vs 'raw spend', 3) run a cheap sim to show "if we disabled prefetch X, estimated unit cost delta" (admin only).

Noah: Love it. Telemetry caveats: don't explode cardinality. Add `prefetch_id`, `prefetch_origin`, `kv_credit_tokens`, and `route_affinity` to invocation events, but keep those optional fields. Prefer doing rollups in batch.

Sam: From ETL side: agree on rollups. Plan: ingest sampled rows (1/20 for alpha) with `sample_weight`. Nightly job produces tile JSONs: list of {prefetch_id, consuming_route, uses, tokens_used, estimated_savings}. Keep tiles partitioned by date+route for fast Console fetch. SQL proto:
```sql
SELECT prefetch_id, consuming_route, COUNT(*) AS uses, SUM(tokens) AS tokens_used
FROM raw_invocations_sampled
WHERE ts >= now() - interval '7 days'
GROUP BY prefetch_id, consuming_route;
```
We'll compute estimated_savings by pairing invocations where fallback occurred.

Iris: UI: show p50/p95 token cost and a small "noisy" badge when effective_n < 30. Also display standard error so teams don't take noisy cells as gospel. Add a help tooltip that links to the math doc.

Aria: Good call. For privacy, sampled invocation rows must be redacted: show hashed invocation id, truncated user agent, and no text fields. Also allow org-level opt-out of sampled invocation exposure.

Noah: Add `fallback_reason` to events so we can detect canary vs capacity fallbacks. Also `prefetch_origin` to distinguish shared system prefetch vs user-requested prefetch.

Sam: Rollout plan: feature-flagged alpha `prefetch_sleuth_alpha` for internal orgs. ETL job infra/ETL-602 scheduled MON+THU for first two weeks; sample 1/20. If stable, increase cadence. I'll own infra PR.

infra-bot: console-service: feature flag `prefetch_sleuth_alpha` enabled for orgs: redwood-internal. Canary rollout 4% traffic.

Iris: One more interaction idea 11: clickable "top consumers" list in each cell that filters the heatmap to show only routes that used that prefetch. Helps product owners find consumers quickly.

Aria: Love that. Timeline suggestion: mockups + doc in 5 days, ETL PR in 7 days, internal alpha in 12 days. I'll post mock images and the formulas (amortized vs marginal vs raw) in a followup. Thanks :raised_hands:
file_comment: panel prototype discussion: Prefetch sleuth panel for cost heatmap (attribution, sampling, rollups, privacy)
